name: Nest Food Bar
address: The Boatshed, Long St, Thesen Island, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: Modern waterfront spot on Thesen Island serving craft cocktails and contemporary share plates with Knysna Lagoon views.
description_long:
Perched in The Boatshed on Thesen Island, Nest Food Bar brings a relaxed contemporary vibe to Knysna's waterfront dining scene. The open-plan space flows onto a deck overlooking the lagoon, making it ideal for sundowners with craft cocktails in hand or leisurely lunches watching the boats drift by.

The menu leans into sharing plates and modern comfort food, with wood-fired pizzas, fresh seafood, and generous salads that work well for groups. The cocktail list shows real care, and the laid-back service matches the island's easy pace. It's the kind of place where you settle in for longer than planned, whether you're catching up with friends or winding down after exploring the lagoon.

Thesen Island's boardwalks and shops are right on your doorstep, and the waterfront setting adds a holiday feel even for locals. Nest hits the sweet spot between casual and considered—no fuss, just good food and drinks in a setting that reminds you why Knysna works its magic on visitors.
